hooks.name: Python format + lint fix
hooks.description: On save of a backend Python file, apply ruff's safe lint fixes then ruff format. Idempotent: a second run changes nothing, so a save it triggers converges after one no-op pass.

action.command: cmd /c "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\ruff.exe check --fix --quiet --exit-zero app tests alembic && .venv\Scripts\ruff.exe format --quiet app tests alembic"
